method.scope: All 300 original held-out episodes, including 150 review-arm episodes and 123 actual reviewer calls. Read-only offline replay; no provider request, changed output, retry, or grade replacement.
method.snapshot_reconstruction: Reconstruct immutable EvidenceSnapshot objects from stored original snapshots; JSON page-number lists are restored to the production tuple type. The evidence text, citation IDs, requirements and raw reviewer output remain byte-for-byte unchanged.
method.provenance_checks: Every saved review_input.evidence matches an observed snapshot; rebuilding the original production messages matches every stored prompt_sha256. Every diagnostic raw line is hashed, and final source files are verified against the frozen protocol.
method.failure_count_semantics: First production failure is mutually exclusive per reviewer call. Citation mismatch categories count all observed malformed citations and can occur multiple times within one call.
method.whitespace_comparison: Whitespace folding and hyphenated line-wrap comparison are diagnostic string comparisons only. Normalized output is never sent to the validator and no invalid trial becomes valid or sufficient.
method.semantic_limit: A validator-accepted sufficient verdict is not an independent correctness grade. Exact citation matching checks source-span integrity, not whether all requested facts are semantically entailed. Semantic benefit estimates must use the separately frozen scoring protocol.
method.projection_limit: No mismatch was found in the captured reviewer-input, snapshot, prompt-hash or final-fingerprint chain. This is evidence for these recorded executions, not proof about every production path.

findings: The 53 invalid public verdicts replay as 48 first-failure exact-citation rejections and 5 first-failure reason-length rejections. These are real production validation failures, not the benchmark equality-gate false alarms.

Of 119 malformed citations, 116 differ only in whitespace/newlines; one joins a hyphenated line break; two splice table fragments while omitting intervening numeric cells. The table cases show why unrestricted fuzzy quote acceptance would lose source-span integrity.
The five rejected reasons contain 442 to 875 characters versus the validator limit of 400. The current system prompt requests a short explanation but does not state the 400-character maximum.
All 123 reviewer completions finished with stop, using 176 to 911 completion tokens below the requested 1024 limit. No observed invalid result was caused by output-token truncation.

Twenty-seven review episodes consumed all 15 initial exploration steps before any reviewer request. Four other unverified outcomes exhausted the bounded correction without a second accepted review. Three of those four also changed the final evidence packet, correctly preventing reuse of the first verdict.
The recorded evidence and prompt-hash chain is consistent for both Micron and SpaceX; these failures do not show a production evidence projection mismatch.
candidate_followups_for_a_separate_futur: Make the reason-length and collection-size limits explicit in the reviewer contract, and expose concise machine-readable validation reason codes for diagnosis without logging evidence or credentials.

Evaluate citation selection by source span or stable line identifiers that the server resolves back to exact original text. Keep multiple disjoint table spans as separate citations; do not silently stitch or normalize the current run outputs.

Evaluate reserving review capacity within the original shared 15-step budget before exploration consumes it. Preserve the existing wall-clock and corrective bounds, and measure retrieval losses as well as completion gains.
Keep the current 300 outcomes and grades unchanged. Any prompt, span representation or scheduling improvement needs a new frozen protocol and fresh evaluation evidence.
